candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Pet Selection to Build Emotional Investment
candidates.change: Shift sign-in step to occur after users choose and personalize their desktop pet. Users complete adoption first, making them far more motivated to sign in and save progress.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right at the beginning. Moving authentication after adoption builds motivation before asking for credentials.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed and retains all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Moving sign-in post-adoption leverages motivation but requires significant flow refactoring.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Control Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding that demonstrates shortcut keys, dragging the pet, and toggling visibility.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet once on the desktop.

new_desktop_controls.headline: How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion
new_desktop_controls.body: Quick shortcuts to move, talk to, or minimize your pet anytime.

components.text: Alt+P to toggle visibility | Click & Drag to relocate | Right-click for pet menu

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Live Interactive Stage Redesign for Pet Selection
candidates.change: Redesign the pet pick screen into an animated showcase stage with instant preview animations and preset choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a high dropoff (60.9% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s) and support emails note custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Preview animations live on stage before finalizing.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen retains its core function of letting the user select a pet.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the largest dropoff stage backed by both long funnel times and support ticket complaints.

candidates.title: Account Restore Sub-Flow for Returning Users
candidates.change: Add a restore pet sub-flow on the sign-in screen allowing returning users to reclaim existing profiles directly during onboarding.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 support emails (the top category) about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

new_restore_pet.headline: Restore an Existing Pet
new_restore_pet.body: Already have a companion? Sign in to bring your saved pet to this device.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet to your account across reinstalls.

guard.reason: screen 'new_restore_pet' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Progress Bar and Mini-Tips for Desktop Pet Initialization
candidates.change: Add a live progress bar, estimated time remaining, and rotating desktop tips during the pet loading screen.
candidates.why: The waiting screen ('home' step) takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs due to perceived app stalls.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Your Desktop...

guard.reason: 'waiting.components[0]': timer text must read like 'About 4 min left' (at most 30 min)

candidates.title: Clear Account Continuity Copy on Sign-In
candidates.change: Add clear copy emphasizing that signing in protects pet save states and prevents accidental pet resets.
candidates.why: Users confuse new guest sessions with existing accounts, resulting in support tickets about lost pets after re-signing in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet Profile
sign_in.body: Use your primary account so your pet's memory, items, and personality are never lost.
sign_in.hint: Always use the same login option to access your saved pet.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain account protection benefits is allowed and does not violate any rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change directly addressing support confusion around guest accounts.

candidates.title: Split Card Layout with Direct Path Recommendations
candidates.change: Reformat the path selection screen into side-by-side split comparison cards highlighting estimated setup times.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean of 514s and drops ~24% of users right at the first choice.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Begin
choose_path.body: Select pre-made companion for instant setup or custom generator for unique traits.

guard.reason: The split layout redesign clearly presents both pre-made adoption and custom creation paths, retaining the screen's core job.

candidates.score_note: Helps resolve high mean duration (514s) at the first step via clearer path layout.

candidates.title: Audio Chime and Desktop Active Badge on Completion
candidates.change: Play a welcoming chime and show an active overlay badge on final onboarding screen when pet renders on the screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails report pets failing to show up on desktop or users not realizing the app opened.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Check your taskbar and screen corner. Your pet is now active.

guard.reason: Adding an audio chime and overlay badge on the home intro screen is allowed under onboarding notifications/intro rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly resolves reported issue of users not realizing app completion via audio/visual feedback.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines and Quality Hint
candidates.change: Display explicit lighting and photo requirements on custom pet photo submission.
candidates.why: Custom pet creation fails or renders incorrectly for multiple users during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Photos for Best Results
upload_photos.body: Provide a front-facing photo in good lighting to generate an accurate 3D desktop companion.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid dark lighting or crowded backgrounds.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Welcome Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign intro story screen into an engaging full-screen story scroll featuring mascot animations.
candidates.why: Improve initial user engagement before the choose_path decision where 23.8% of users drop off.

intro_story.text: Meet a virtual companion that lives directly on your computer desktop.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

lessons_next: Evidence for sign_in/reorder, finish/notification, and choose_path/layout is still thin as each has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests compared to measured results.
